title: Who Gave the Trophy a Mustache?
story: An hour before the Harbor Days awards, the sandcastle trophy turned up on the prize table wearing a curly mustache in grease pencil. It wipes right off, and the committee admits the trophy has never looked more distinguished. Still, five people had been near the table, and each has one statement to make. Can you find the artist before the awards begin?
did: drew the mustache on the trophy
didnt: didn't draw the mustache on the trophy
texts: Neither Vera nor I drew the mustache on the trophy.
Gideon didn't draw the mustache on the trophy.
Neither Gideon nor Priya drew the mustache on the trophy.
rule_text: Exactly one of these statements is true.

question.text: Who drew the mustache on the trophy?
